title: How to Slow Aging (and even reverse it)
summary: Veritasium presents David Sinclair's information theory of aging, which says aging is a loss of epigenetic information, and the evidence that aging can be slowed or reversed. It touches on stressors like fasting, exercise and cold exposure.
why: HN references it as the source of ideas like cold exposure and body stress for longevity, though some commenters criticize its claims as overreaching.

quote.text: there is evidence to support the idea that various activities which are stressful for the body are good at slowing or even reversing ageing
